notes.title: New important update!
notes.content:
Hi Warriors!
First: MERRY CHRISTMAS! ː16bitHeartː
Then, thank you to playing Roar of Revenge. Thanks yours feedbacks, we updated Roar of Revenge!

[b]These are the new features:[/b]
- Added 3 languages: Spanish, Deutch and Russian!
- New music, improve general sound!
- Now you can use Shoulder Attack with only a button!
- Fixed some bugs.
- Fixed some graphics!

...Warriors, you're great, thanks to support our games! ː16bitHeartː
